title: Introduce staged release sandbox and compact lint router
author: Morgan Li
description: Motivation: We frequently see long-running release hooks and monolithic lint pipelines delaying merges and producing noisy failures downstream. This PR introduces a lightweight, stage-aware release sandbox for preflight verification and replaces the top-heavy monolithic lint workflow with a compact lint router that dispatches targeted lint shards based on changed paths. Goals: 1) shorten presubmit feedback for most PRs, 2) isolate release-side effects in a sandboxed step that can run asynchronously, 3) reduce CI cost by avoiding unnecessary full-lint runs, and 4) make rollout reversible with feature flags. What this changes: - New scripts/release/sandbox-invoke.sh: a minimal, hermetic sandbox runner that reproduces release hooks (changelog validation, artifact dry-run, signature check) in ~90s on CI images. - CI: ci/workflows/release-sandbox.yml added as a staged post-merge gated job that can be toggled via repo settings. - Lint: ci/workflows/lint-router.yml replaces the previous lint.yml. The router inspects the git diff and maps files to lint shards (js/ts, python, go, infra). For small diffs the router runs a single shard and reports results quickly. - Tooling: scripts/ci/path-mapper.py implements the diff->shard mapping and includes heuristics to prefer fast linters for docs/markdown. - Rollout: feature flag infra/ci:enable_sandbox set to false by default; ops can flip per-branch. Checklist: - [x] Add sandbox job + script - [x] Implement lint router and path mapper - [x] Add unit tests for path-mapper - [x] Update README/CONTRIBUTING with new CI guidance - [x] Canary rollout to non-critical repos (done) - [x] End-to-end smoke: create+merge test PR in staging (passed) Testing summary: unit tests for path-mapper (100% branch coverage on mapping heuristics), local end-to-end against a small sample repo, canary runs across three internal repos for 48h with 0 regressions in lint detection. CI behaviour: initial runs will still run the monolithic lint in a fallback lane for PRs that modify >200 files; that fallback will be removed after two weeks of monitoring. Migration notes: maintainers should consult CONTRIBUTING.md updates which describe how to opt-in/out, and how to add file patterns to the router mapping. Related: ENG-2847 (CI cost targets), ENG-2910 (release automation hygiene).

release_notes: Introduce a staged release sandbox and compact lint router to improve presubmit feedback times and reduce CI cost. Default behavior unchanged until feature flag enabled. See CONTRIBUTING.md for opt-in instructions.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag infra/ci:enable_sandbox=false by default. To enable: update infrastructure/flags/ci_flags.yaml on main and flip flag, monitor sandbox job duration and prometheus metric ci_sandbox_duration_seconds. Fallback behavior removed after two-week observation window if no regressions observed.
